name: Jhenaidah

queries.query: Jhenaidah Bangladesh official cadastral map land records parcel map
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS) online settlement map and official digital land-map portals. The Jhenaidah district administration page documents the local service for obtaining Mouza maps. No public anonymous parcel feature service was identified in search results.

queries.query: ঝিনাইদহ সরকারি ভূমি নকশা খতিয়ান মৌজা ম্যাপ
queries.result: বাংলা ভাষার প্রথম-পক্ষ অনুসন্ধানে DLRS-এর অনলাইন ভূমি রেকর্ড ও জরিপ ব্যবস্থাপনা, স্মার্ট ভূমি নকশা এবং ঝিনাইদহ জেলা প্রশাসনের মৌজা ম্যাপ সেবা পাওয়া গেছে। উন্মুক্ত বেনামী পার্সেল ফিচার সার্ভিস পাওয়া যায়নি।

officialLeads.operator: Department of Land Records and Surveys, Ministry of Land, Bangladesh
officialLeads.scope: Online search for survey maps and plot/dag records by division, district, survey, upazila, mouza and sheet.
officialLeads.evidence: The official map-search UI exposes district/survey/upazila/mouza/sheet/plot selectors and a GeoJSON sheet route.

officialLeads.scope: Local district service for obtaining Mouza maps and certified survey records.
officialLeads.evidence: The district service list names Mouza map delivery and identifies the district record-room custodian.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.outcome: Official DLRS settlement portal loaded; it links map display and land-record search.
Official map-search UI loaded. Inspected current JavaScript configuration and found POST/GET routes for division, district, survey, upazila, mouza, sheet and GeoJSON sheet retrieval.
Returned division list; Khulna division native unit code 020000000 was identified.
Returned Jhenaidah district as native unit code 020400000 and company code 4166.
Returned RS survey 201901, marked manual survey and ongoing.
Returned an empty list for Jhenaidah district 020400000 and RS survey 201901; no upazila/mouza/sheet route could be selected in this public map workflow.
Returned a Jhenaidah district boundary GeoJSON MultiPolygon. This is administrative boundary evidence, not parcel geometry, and was not retained as a parcel sample.
Official Smart Bhumi Naksha landing page loaded; inspected current HTML/JavaScript references. No anonymous parcel feature endpoint was exposed on the landing route.
Official district service page loaded and documented Mouza map and certified survey-record services.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: Settlement MapSearch.js exposes /Khatian/GetSheetJsonBySurvey as GeoJSON for a selected sheet, but no sheet was reachable for this Jhenaidah route.
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Not observed for a parcel response.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: Not obtained; no synthetic identity created.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Bangladesh DLRS survey-map and land-record services, with Jhenaidah district service evidence.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official local/national map portals and an administrative boundary response; no open parcel ID-plus-geometry response verified.

qualification.reason: A real local registry/cadastre custodian and current public map workflow are evidenced, but no anonymous native parcel identity-plus-geometry response, parcel schema, CRS, or adapter route was qualified.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted.
No parcel polygon retained because no safe native parcel geometry response was obtained.
An empty upazila-list response is a route/data-availability limitation, not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, personal, tax/account or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or runtime admission.
remainingUncertainty: The public portal may have additional survey coverage, map sheets, or authenticated/non-indexed routes. Jhenaidah city-level parcel coverage, stable parcel identity semantics, parcel CRS, update cadence and adapter behavior remain unverified.
identityPolicy: Do not synthesize a parcel ID; retain only a native parcel identity if a source exposes one.
